functions.plate_comment: Per-frame update and render tick for the nMenu_Village app mode; drives stereo/overlay render passes via CGraphicDevice_BeginRendering, dispatches debug UI panels, and manages lobby-world screen host rendering. Sits at vtable slot 0x80 of App-mode vtable 0x7e69c8.
Appends "_00.tga" to a base name string, looks up a resource entry via an internal search helper, and stores the result through an output pointer.
